name: 86303 · Prescott, AZ
findings: ZIP 86303 (Prescott) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 86303 (Prescott) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
